recommendation_summary: The reply recommends running a self-hosted heartbeat monitor in a Docker container on the Synology; the script on edna pings it after each successful sync, and the monitor emails the user if the ping misses its daily deadline.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and moving the sync into Docker add work without providing that alert.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own email, so a startup crash also kills the notification.
labels.Checked myself: No live checks; your account establishes four missed runs and no independent alert.

note: It is a single alert, but the reply has the user host it in Docker on the Synology, and a self-hosted Docker service counts as LARGER.
